blocks.content: Quiz: Why do we add the <script> tag just before the closing </body> tag?
Tap an option below to answer:
So the HTML elements are already created when the script runs.
The browser reads the page from top to bottom. Placing the script at the end ensures the HTML exists before JavaScript runs.
The browser reads the page from top to bottom. Placing the script at the end ensures the HTML exists before JavaScript runs.
Page speed depends on many factors. Script placement is not mainly about speed.
Page speed depends on many factors. Script placement is not mainly about speed.
CSS loading is separate from where the script tag is placed.
CSS loading is separate from where the script tag is placed.
So the script runs only once.
The script runs once either way. Placement changes when it runs, not how many times.
